description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractTask' which serves as a base class for all other task classes in the OpenMRS scheduler module. It provides basic lifecycle management, initialization, and execution control functionalities for scheduled tasks.

classes.name: AbstractTask
classes.description: An abstract base class for scheduled tasks, providing lifecycle management, initialization, and execution state tracking.

methods.name: AbstractTask(TaskDefinition)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with a given TaskDefinition and logs its name.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses, defining the task's execution logic.

methods.name: isExecuting()
methods.description: Returns whether the task is currently executing.

methods.name: initialize(TaskDefinition)
methods.description: Initializes the task with a specified TaskDefinition.

methods.name: getTaskDefinition()
methods.description: Retrieves the current TaskDefinition associated with the task.

methods.name: shutdown()
methods.description: Shuts down the task by nullifying its TaskDefinition.

methods.name: startExecuting()
methods.description: Callback indicating the task has started executing.

methods.name: stopExecuting()
methods.description: Callback indicating the task has stopped executing.
